corrections.finding: "a map, a program, a magnetic sense and a memory" stands as the set's own words (memory, magnetic sense) rather than marked as the field's phrases; crane saying itself matches the 4.6 crane bullet (route straightening with older birds).
corrections.fixed_text: A salmon lives with its genome, an artifact of its kind's prior living, year round, in healthy living and ingesting conditions, river and ocean; that artifact's stable form co-sequentially, geodesically aims a salmon into healthy living, out to the waters where its kind feeds well and home up its river at its season, from each is-not to is. A "map", a "program", a "magnetic sense" and a "memory" going down generations are a field's store story over that. A young self opens with two priors: its elders' going, a crane's route straightening as it flies with older cranes, and its kind's artifact, a salmon's heading with no ocean of its own yet.

corrections.finding: Stronger than source: "swim south" / "swim north" where Putman et al. say the fish "tended to" swim that way (present form "tend to" used, since past is a dead word); "copper coils" where source says copper wires in a platform; "far-southern" edge dropped; "its southern edge" and "no ocean of its own prior" unclear; long sentence misparses "reads at the northern edge"; "Its authors" has no clear antecedent.
corrections.fixed_text: Juvenile Chinook salmon from a hatchery, more than 1,000 of them, none ever in the ocean, each some eight minutes in a bucket inside a platform of copper wires making a field an instrument reads as that of the northern edge of their kind's ocean range, tend to swim south, and with the field of the far southern edge of that range, tend to swim north, toward the waters where their kind feeds; in the test site's own field they swim in random directions. The researchers name it a map sense a fish inherits, a fish "programmed to know what to do": a self observing reads a young salmon's heading toward its kind's healthy feeding as one with no ocean yet of its own, its genome an artifact of its kind's prior living and its stable form aiming it.
